investigation_of_stage3d_claim.original_claim: Stage 3D stated that future research requires 220 consecutive days of live warmup logging followed by 60 days of prespecified exploratory evaluation.
investigation_of_stage3d_claim.root_cause: Stage 3D conflated the concept of 'historical market bar warmup' with 'prospective calendar waiting time'.

warmup_definition.calendar_days: Approximately 10 to 11 calendar months of historical market data
warmup_definition.purpose: Provides sufficient lookback history so that trailing technical indicators (e.g., 50-day SMA, 60-day momentum, 200-day trend filters) can be computed accurately from the very first decision tick (tick 1).
warmup_definition.how_supplied_in_competition: Supplied AUTOMATICALLY by the competition evaluation platform (preview.py or live_runner.py) in the market_state dictionary at tick 1. Competitors do NOT wait 220 calendar days.
warmup_definition.how_supplied_in_prospective_research: Retrieved via a single batch API call for historical EOD daily bars (e.g. from Tiingo or Alpaca) on initialization. Requires zero live observation days to seed.

competition_evaluation.dates: July 7, 2026 to November 9, 2026 (US market open to close)
competition_evaluation.scoring_rule: Forward percentage return calculated from each entrant's official ENTRY date through November 9, 2026. Prior history is dropped on revision.

local_admission_preview.nature: Offline diagnostic smoke test across 3 public sample market windows
local_admission_preview.windows: calm_uptrend (~252 bars), moderate_selloff (~252 bars), vol_spike_snapback (~252 bars)
local_admission_preview.purpose: Gating safety check (leverage <= 1.5x, concentration <= 30%, max drawdown < 50%). Does not count toward leaderboard ranking.

prospective_exploratory_research_study.proposed_horizon: 60 prospective trading sessions (formulated in Stage 3B as a heuristic evaluation window; power analysis showed 60 sessions provides only ~20.3% power for delta SR=0.20; 252 sessions required for 80% power)
prospective_exploratory_research_study.governance_status: Awaits human owner decision DEC-04 approval. Not bound to competition challenge dates.

reconciliation_summary.competition_track: 220 historical daily bars pre-loaded by platform at tick 1
reconciliation_summary.prospective_track: 220 historical daily bars pre-loaded via historical batch query at startup

reconciliation_summary.competition_track: Occurs on tick 1 using pre-loaded 220 historical bars
reconciliation_summary.prospective_track: Occurs on tick 1 using pre-loaded 220 historical bars

reconciliation_summary.competition_track: First market session after admission receipt is processed by platform
reconciliation_summary.prospective_track: First live observation session after observer daemon deployment
Prespecified 60 to 252 sessions as approved under DEC-04

unresolved_ambiguity_preserved: The competition live runner's fallback variable EVAL_DAYS = 60 is documented in source comments as '(history sizing only) trailing window used when fetching bars'. It does not constrain the length of the live scoring window, which runs until November 9, 2026.
